full_title: DIY Frost Moss Perfume Recipe | Geranium & Cocoa | Valentine's Day Gift | Digital Download
instructions: Pour 9.4ml jojoba oil into the 10ml roller bottle using the small funnel, leaving a little headroom.

Add the essential oil blend in this order: 2 drops Grapefruit Essential Oil, 2 drops Mandarin Essential Oil, 1 drop Petitgrain Essential Oil (top notes), then 3 drops Geranium Essential Oil, 3 drops Rose Absolute, 2 drops Jasmine Absolute (heart notes), then 1 drop Cocoa Absolute, 2 drops Sandalwood Essential Oil (base notes).
Cap the bottle tightly and roll it between your palms 20 times to blend everything evenly.
Label the bottle with the recipe name and date, then let the perfume rest for 48 hours before first use.
safety_notes: Keep essential oils and the finished fragrance out of reach of children and pets.
Patch test on a small area of skin before regular use.
Do not apply to broken or irritated skin.
Keep away from eyes and mucous membranes.
Store in a cool, dark place away from direct sunlight.
If pregnant, nursing, or under medical care, ask a healthcare provider before use.
Contains phototoxic citrus oil (Grapefruit) — avoid sun/UV exposure on treated skin for 12+ hours after application.

How It Works

Safety & Tips
